items.stem: What is the first step when repairing a reported defect in Cursor?

options.text: Reproduce the defect as a failing test
options.rationale: Correct: a failing test gives a precise signal to fix against.

options.text: Rewrite the whole module to be safe
options.rationale: A broad rewrite ignores the specific defect.
Coverage does not reproduce the bug.
Removing the feature is not a repair.

items.stem: Which TWO signs show a generated test is actually useful? (Select TWO.)

options.text: It asserts the intended behaviour, not just that code ran
options.rationale: Correct: meaningful assertions are what give a test value.

options.text: It fails when the behaviour is broken
options.rationale: Correct: a test that cannot fail protects nothing.

options.text: It always passes regardless of the code
options.rationale: A test that never fails gives false confidence.

options.text: It raises the coverage number with no assertions
options.rationale: Coverage without assertions is false confidence.

items.explanation: Correct: meaningful assertions are what give a test value.

items.stem: An AI fix makes the failing test pass. What still must be confirmed?

options.text: That the fix addresses the root cause, not just the symptom
options.rationale: Correct: a green test can still leave the root cause in place.

options.text: That the commit message is long enough
options.rationale: Message length is irrelevant to correctness.
Total coverage is not the goal here.

options.text: That the agent wrote it quickly
